author: A Google user
review_text: Hello eSewa! Would you please add an option to choose between sim 1 & sim 2 for sending sms? I had to open an account via a Ncell number and my account is a verified one. But doing transactions via Ncell number takes Rs 0.50 per sms, so I added a NTC number too but, everytime I try to do transactions using sim 2, it always send sms through sim 1 (Ncell) which is deducting my sim's balance. In short, I am not able to perform transactions using my NTC number.
